name: Arion Sherwind
description: Raimon’s new captain in GO, a wind-element midfielder who only wants soccer to be free again — and whose keshin, Pegasus, carries the whole team.

name: Riccardo Di Rigo
description: Raimon’s captain and playmaker when GO begins: the “maestro” of the pitch, who reads a match like a score and conducts his team through it.

name: Fei Rune
description: A boy from the future who joins Raimon in Chrono Stones, to save soccer from the agents who want it erased from history.

name: Gabriel Garcia
description: Raimon’s defender with the pink twin tails, Riccardo’s oldest friend and the calm at the back of the team.

name: Bailong
description: The white-haired prodigy of God Eden, the Fifth Sector’s strongest Seed — and a rival who ends up fighting alongside Arion.

name: Simeon Ayp
description: Captain of Feida, the gifted children of the future who stand against the world in the last arc of Chrono Stones.

name: Zanark Avalonic
description: The wild time traveller of Chrono Stones, who plays soccer by his own rules and answers to no one.

name: Alpha
description: Captain of Protocol Omega, the cold agent sent from the future to wipe soccer out of history.

name: Aitor Cazador
description: A new defender who turned up at Raimon during the Holy Road, with a smile that hides more than it shows.

name: Sol Daystar
description: The sun-bright ace of Arakumo Gakuen, a boy who left his hospital bed to face Arion in the Holy Road.

name: Tezcat
description: The mysterious boy of God Eden’s forest, who plays soccer for a promise made long ago.

name: Jean-Pierre Lapin
description: Raimon’s smallest player, Arion’s first friend in the club, who can jump higher than anyone — and becomes a keeper.

name: Vladimir Blade
description: Victor’s older brother, whose injured legs are the reason Victor joined the Fifth Sector.

name: Beta
description: Captain of Protocol Omega 2.0: all sweet smiles, until the match turns against her.

name: Gamma
description: Captain of Protocol Omega 3.0, the proud agent who never forgives a defeat.

name: Goldie Lemmon
description: A cheerful girl who joins Raimon on its journey through time in Chrono Stones.

name: Clark von Wunderbar
description: The talking blue teddy bear from the future who coaches Raimon through time in Chrono Stones.

name: Skie Blue
description: Raimon’s manager in GO and Arion’s childhood friend.

name: Samguk Han
description: Raimon’s goalkeeper when GO begins, the steady senior in the goal.

name: Michael Ballzack
description: Raimon’s sharp-tongued forward in GO.

name: Wanli Changcheng
description: Raimon’s big defender in GO, a wall at the back.

name: Adé Kébé
description: One of Raimon’s players in Inazuma Eleven GO.

name: Eugene Peabody
description: One of Raimon’s players in Inazuma Eleven GO.

name: Subaru Honda
description: One of Raimon’s defenders in Inazuma Eleven GO.

name: Doug McArthur
description: Raimon’s forward when Inazuma Eleven GO begins.

name: Jade Greene
description: One of Raimon’s managers in Inazuma Eleven GO.

name: Rosie Redd
description: One of Raimon’s managers in Inazuma Eleven GO, never without her camera.

name: Hugues Baudet
description: One of Raimon’s players in Inazuma Eleven GO.

name: Shunsuke Aoyama
description: One of Raimon’s players in Inazuma Eleven GO.

name: God Hand
description: Mark Evans’s catch: with spirit and guts, a huge golden hand that stops any shot. His grandfather’s technique, found in an old notebook.

name: Fire Tornado
description: Axel Blaze’s shot: he spins up into the air and kicks down a ball wrapped in fierce flame.

name: The Earth
description: A combination shot that gathers the power of the whole Earth into one ball.

name: Majin Pegasus Arc
description: Arion’s keshin grown into its true form: the winged horse, spreading its red wings over the pitch.

name: Majin The Hand
description: Mark Evans’s catch that calls forth the giant from his own heart: the legend of Inazuma, reborn.

name: Eternal Blizzard
description: Shawn Froste’s shot, with such destructive power that it freezes everything in its path.

name: Death Zone
description: Three players leap into a triangle of death and shoot together: Royal Academy’s signature.

name: Emperor Penguin No. 2
description: A cute name and a fearsome shot: penguins burst out of the ground and fly with the ball into the goal.

name: Inazuma Break
description: Mark, Axel and Jude together: one shot, charged with lightning.

name: Wolf Legend
description: Shawn Froste’s howling shot, the ice wolf charging at the goal.

name: Kensei Lancelot
description: Victor Blade’s keshin: the armoured swordsman, whose blade cuts through any defence.

name: Saikyou Eleven Hadou
description: The strongest wind shot of GO, Riccardo and Victor striking as one.

name: Last Resort
description: The ball snakes over the pitch like a dragon, shaking the ground around it on its way to the goal.

name: Mugen The Hand
description: Darren LaChance’s catch, the secret technique said to be a myth: countless hands that stop the ball dead.

name: Ijigen The Hand
description: Mark Evans’s catch that wraps the goal in a dome of energy and turns the ball away.

name: Bakunetsu Screw
description: Axel Blaze’s burning screw shot, drilling through the air to the goal.

name: Dragon Tornado
description: Kevin Dragonfly’s dragon and Axel Blaze’s fire in one shot.

name: Grand Fire
description: Three strikers, one blazing shot: a fireball as big as the goal.

name: Heaven Drive
description: Byron Love’s shot from the heavens, struck with wings of light.

name: Chaos Break
description: Claude Beacons’s fire and Bryce Whitingale’s ice, kicked together into chaos.

name: Fire Blizzard
description: Axel Blaze and Shawn Froste: fire and ice in a single shot.

name: Tenkuu Otoshi
description: Xavier Foster’s shot: not a shooting star — the whole starry sky falling onto the goal.

name: Fortissimo
description: Riccardo Di Rigo’s shot, struck as loud as the last note of a symphony.

name: Death Drop
description: Victor Blade’s overhead kick, the ball wrapped in a jet-black aura.

name: Bakunetsu Storm
description: A storm of fire blowing everything over: Axel Blaze’s scorching shot.

name: The Wall
description: Jack Wallside jumps and lands as a wall of rock in front of the goal.

name: Spinning Cut
description: A sharp roundhouse kick at the opponent’s feet, the shock wave stealing the ball.

name: Illusion Ball
description: Jude Sharp’s trick: the ball splits into many, and only he knows which one is real.

name: Twin Boost
description: Jude Sharp and Axel Blaze: one kicks, the other sends it on twice as hard.

name: Ice Ground
description: Shawn Froste’s block: the ground freezes, and the opponent with it.

name: Soyokaze Step
description: Arion’s dribble, slipping past like a gentle breeze.

name: Mach Wind
description: Arion’s shot, the ball carried on a howling wind.

name: Jet Stream
description: A combination shot fired along a jet of air, faster with every touch.

name: Tiger Storm
description: Bakunetsu Storm and Tiger Drive combined: the power of two shots in one.

name: Death Sword
description: Victor Blade’s first shot, the ball cutting like a black blade.

name: Pegasus Shot
description: A soaring shot that takes wing like Pegasus.
